name: jacky-image
description: Jacky Image - AI 图像生成工作台

scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.desktop:prepare: node scripts/remove-intelligent-conversation-residue.mjs && npm run renderer:build && node scripts/generate-electron-icon.mjs && node scripts/prepare-electron-runtime.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:debug
scripts.desktop:make: node scripts/ensure-desktop-prepare.mjs && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && node scripts/build-windows-installer.mjs && node scripts/collect-electron-artifacts.mjs

author: Jacky Image Contributors
